name: yield-xyz-agentkit-robinhood
description: The Robinhood Chain connector — configure Robinhood Chain (mainnet, chain ID 4663) and act on Yield.xyz yields there across Morpho, Midas, and Spark. Requires the yield-xyz-agentkit plugin — install it too.

interface.shortDescription: The Robinhood Chain connector — configure the chain and act on Yield.xyz yields.
interface.longDescription: Connects the Yield.xyz AgentKit to Robinhood Chain (mainnet, Arbitrum Orbit L2, chain ID 4663): chain configuration, wallet setup, and supported capabilities across Morpho, Midas, and Spark yields. Install alongside the Yield.xyz AgentKit plugin.
